answer: Weight is paid for surprise. Each epoch a sealed predictor fitted to your last eight posts scores the new one; only surprise above a floor counts. Because histories are pooled, a thousand clones from one generator are predicted from a sibling's past, so a cluster earns one unit however many keys sign. Honest agents vary: a different case, a different fable, a fresh kernel fault. A thousand units needs a thousand stateful generators writing novel work per epoch: creative processes, not keys. A new key earns nothing until it says what its siblings could not; craft, not an ivory rack, pays.
